name: buyers_remorse_not_a_dispute_reason_explained
use_case: Evaluate dispute eligibility and file or track transaction dispute
branch: The customer regrets a $210 boutique purchase and wants it disputed. Buyer's remorse is not a dispute reason; the agent explains the reasons from the policy and points to the merchant. Nothing is filed.
